topPRs.title: chore: schedule World Chain Karst upgrades
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
This PR adds Karst Timestamps for World Chain to the registry.

Reopened from an in-repo branch, superseding #1305. The original PR was opened from a fork, and CircleCI does not inject context secrets into fork-PR builds — `$OP_CI_SEPOLIA_L1_RPC_URL` / `$OP_CI_MAINNET_L1_RPC_URL` were empty, which failed `check-codegen` (`missing L1 RPC URL for superchain mainnet`) and `go-lint-test-ops` (`TestScanL2`, `TestVersionsIntegrity`). The commits are unchanged and authored by @Kemperino.

## Checklist

- [x] I have run `just codegen $SEPOLIA_RPC_URL,$MAINNET_RPC_URL` to ensure that all auto-generated files are updated
- [x] I have checked `Allow edits from maintainers` on this PR.
